subject.title: fix(browser): prevent remote browser timeout stalls and cancellation conflicts

question: Do the Browser owners accept this timeout-budget and abort-signal change after reviewing a real remote Browser-node run that cancels one request while concurrent Browser actions complete?
rationale: The patch changes nested watchdog ownership and cancellation propagation in a user-facing remote execution path; tests are substantial, but the available proof does not directly exercise the deployed remote Browser-node boundary.

options.title: Require remote-node proof before merge
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal/log or recorded run through a real remote Browser node that shows the inner timeout and isolates one cancellation from concurrent requests.

options.title: Accept focused test evidence
options.body: Merge based on the added proxy and Browser-tool regressions if Browser owners judge their mocks sufficient for this transport boundary.

recommendation.title: Require remote-node proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal/log or recorded run through a real remote Browser node that shows the inner timeout and isolates one cancellation from concurrent requests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the author of the relevant Browser runtime and regression-test change; current-main ownership history was not independently available.
